case_title: Madhao And Anr. v. State Of Maharashtra And Anr.
neutral_facts: The Government of Maharashtra implemented a scheme to provide land to Scheduled Castes and neo-Buddhists below the poverty line. Appellants were involved in executing sale deeds under this scheme. A complaint was filed alleging that land was purchased from a deceased person. The magistrate directed police to investigate under Section 156(3) of the Code of Criminal Procedure. The investigation found no evidence of wrongdoing, and the case was dismissed. The appellants were acquitted as the magistrate's order for investigation was deemed lawful and did not violate any procedural rules.
